title: thelypteris obstructa
intro: Thelypteris obstructa, commonly known as the Osmunda fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris obstructa include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in wound healing and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
